# add composer deps

Add PHP's Composer to the Brewfile, so that the `composer+` alias ([bin/lib/aliases.bash](../../bin/lib/aliases.bash)) and the PHP branch of [bin/update](../../bin/update) have the tool they assume.

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/140#issuecomment-5711681069
